answer_1.quote: Given input such as protein target descriptions, phenotypic data, or other textual information, Assay2Mol retrieves relevant BioAssays and leverages in-context learning to generate molecules with the desired biological activity...

answer_2.quote: We use Vina Dock to score the binding complementarity of a molecule... QED and SA are computed with RDKit... Diversity is quantified as the average pairwise Tanimoto distance between Morgan fingerprint of the generated molecules...
